Note / citation text: Gramsci introduced the concept of cultural hegemony in the Marxist framework. Thus, the socio-economic and political status quo are misrepresented as being natural, inevitable, and beneficial to all classes, rather than being contrived for the exclusive benefit to the ruling class.

Rather than a space of universal knowledge where caste is no longer relevant, what we are seeing is the reconstitution of caste within and through the technical sciences.
